supplements.title: Capilliposides from Lysimachia capillipes: triterpene saponins with potential anticancer activities.
supplements.summary: Capilliposides, compounds from a Chinese herb, kill multiple cancer types by triggering cell death and blocking key cancer-promoting pathways.

supplements.title: n-3 Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids Improve DSS-Induced Acute Colitis in Mice via Intestinal Barrier Fortification and Gut Microbiome Modulation.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 fatty acids improve ulcerative colitis in mice by strengthening the intestinal barrier and modifying gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Fermented Durian Tempoyak as a Source of Probiotics for Colorectal Cancer Prevention through Gut Microbiome Modulation.
supplements.summary: Fermented durian tempoyak, a traditional food rich in probiotics, may help prevent colorectal cancer by improving gut health.

supplements.title: Preventive Health Behaviours Among Elderly in India: Does Social Capital Matter?
supplements.summary: Social connections and community ties help elderly Indians adopt preventive health behaviors like exercise, cancer screening, and vaccinations.

supplements.title: In silico evaluation of garlic-derived organosulfur compounds as multi-target inhibitors of breast cancer biomarkers.
supplements.summary: Garlic compounds, especially Z-ajoene, show promise as multi-target breast cancer treatments with good safety profiles in computational studies.

supplements.title: Rapid regression of advanced hepatic fibrosis in a patient with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease and severe obesity: a case report highlighting lifestyle-induced NETosis activation through serum proteomic analysis.
supplements.summary: Intensive lifestyle intervention reversed advanced liver fibrosis in a severely obese patient, potentially through immune pathway activation.

supplements.title: CD44-Targeting Hydroxyapatite Nanoparticles (HAP) Induce Mitochondrial Dysfunction-Driven PANoptosis and Immunogenic Cell Death (ICD) via Ca Overload in Colorectal Cancer.
supplements.summary: Targeted nanoparticles trigger multiple death pathways in colorectal cancer cells, boosting immune response and overcoming treatment resistance.

supplements.title: The TRIM27/STING Axis Mediates Schisandrin B-Induced Inhibition of Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells Accumulation to Potentiate Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Schisandrin B enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma by reducing immune-suppressive cells through the TRIM27/STING pathway.

supplements.title: Akkermansia muciniphila-derived 5-MIAA blunts colitis-associated tumorigenesis by modulating colonic SLC26A3/pSTAT3 signaling.
supplements.summary: A bacterial metabolite from *Akkermansia muciniphila* reduces colorectal cancer growth by activating a protective signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Urinary phytoestrogens and hyperuricemia risk in a nationally representative population: an effect modified by smoking status.
supplements.summary: Higher urinary phytoestrogens are associated with lower hyperuricemia risk in U.S. adults, especially among current smokers.

supplements.title: The association of time-restricted eating and indices of organ-specific aging in relation to metabolic health and obesity.
supplements.summary: Moderate time-restricted eating with timely breakfast is associated with slower organ aging and better metabolic health compared to extreme eating patterns.

supplements.title: ROS-Responsive Polyprodrug Co-Delivery of Curcumin and Cinnamaldehyde to Disrupt Tumor Redox Homeostasis for Anticancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining curcumin and cinnamaldehyde that respond to cancer cell stress signals, effectively killing breast cancer cells and shrinking tumors.

supplements.title: Fasting opens a metabolic window that favors anti-tumor immunity.
supplements.summary: Short-term fasting boosts tumor-fighting immune cells by increasing a nutrient that strengthens their anti-cancer activity.

supplements.title: A small molecule disrupts G4-STAT1 interaction and synergizes with olaparib to drive cancer cell death.
supplements.summary: Berberine and coptisine block a cancer protein's growth signals and enhance DNA-damaging therapy in colon cancer cells.

supplements.title: 16-h fasting optimizes cancer immunotherapy in mice and humans.
supplements.summary: A 16-hour fasting period boosts cancer immunotherapy effectiveness by improving immune cells' tumor-fighting capacity in mice and humans.

off_label.title: Ketotifen for Preventing Oxaliplatin-Induced Neuropathy in Stage III Colorectal Cancer: a Randomized Controlled Trial.
off_label.summary: Ketotifen may help prevent nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy in stage III colorectal cancer patients.

off_label.title: CKS1B is a tumor-intrinsic factor driving CD8+ T cell exhaustion via maintaining persistent tumor-antigen stimulation.
off_label.summary: CKS1B protein in esophageal cancer tumors exhausts immune cells; blocking it restores anti-tumor immunity and improves checkpoint therapy.

off_label.title: Dutasteride treatment and its effect on standardized uptake values in prostate-specific membrane antigen-PET imaging: A pilot study.
off_label.summary: Dutasteride treatment increased PSMA expression in prostate cancer patients, potentially improving the effectiveness of PSMA-PET imaging for detection.

off_label.title: Enhancing CAR-T Cell Efficacy in Solid Tumors by Inhibiting CCL5/VEGF-Mediated Angiogenesis.
off_label.summary: Blocking CCL5 signaling in CAR-T cells improves their ability to fight solid tumors by preventing unwanted blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: Molecular Glue cc-885 Inhibits VHL-Deficient Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma via ETS1 Degradation.
off_label.summary: cc-885 drug kills kidney cancer cells with VHL mutations by breaking down ETS1 protein, working better combined with belzutifan.

off_label.title: Safety and efficacy of echinocandin antifungal agents in Candida albicans endophthalmitis.
off_label.summary: Echinocandin antifungal drugs rezafungin and anidulafungin effectively treat Candida albicans eye infections with safety comparable to traditional antifungals.

off_label.title: ERα blockade in dendritic cells enhances antigen cross-presentation and induces antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity.
off_label.summary: Blocking estrogen receptor in immune cells enhances their ability to activate cancer-fighting T cells, offering a potential new immunotherapy approach.

off_label.title: A Phase I/II Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of Ivermectin in Combination With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor in Patients With Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether adding ivermectin to immune-boosting drugs can shrink metastatic triple negative breast cancer more effectively.

off_label.title: A Randomized Phase II Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Fezolinetant in Reducing Vasomotor Symptoms in Women With Breast Cancer on Endocrine Therapy
off_label.summary: Fezolinetant reduces hot flashes in breast cancer patients taking hormone therapy, according to this phase II clinical trial.

off_label.title: Progressive alopecia areata during TNF-α inhibition with intralesional corticosteroid failure and subsequent improvement following JAK1 inhibition.
off_label.summary: A patient's hair loss condition, which worsened during rheumatoid arthritis treatment, improved after switching to a JAK1 inhibitor.

off_label.title: The efficacy and safety of pentoxifylline in the treatment of chronic kidney disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Pentoxifylline may improve kidney function, anemia, and inflammation in chronic kidney disease patients, according to this systematic review.

off_label.title: Carvedilol Versus Endoscopic Variceal Ligation for Prophylaxis of Esophageal Variceal Bleeding in Patients With Liver Cirrhosis: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
off_label.summary: Carvedilol and endoscopic ligation are equally effective at preventing dangerous bleeding from esophageal varices in cirrhosis patients.

off_label.title: A network medicine framework for multi-modal data integration in therapeutic target discovery.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a machine learning system combining multiple data types to identify cancer drug targets, discovering ENO2 inhibition effectively fights kidney cancer.

off_label.title: From diabetes to tumor growth: unravelling the impact of glucose-lowering therapies.
off_label.summary: Researchers reviewed how diabetes medications affect cancer risk, finding complex links between blood sugar control, insulin levels, and tumor growth.

off_label.title: A Systems Pharmacology Model of Ageing Identifies Optimal Combination Therapies With Secondary Benefits on Weight Loss and Metabolic Health
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a model showing rapamycin combined with diabetes drugs optimizes both metabolic health and aging-related outcomes better than single therapies.

biomarkers.title: A novel insulin-like growth factor II-based masking domain for conditional activation of therapeutic antibodies.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists engineered a masking protein that blocks therapeutic antibodies until enzymes at disease sites activate them, improving safety and effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Optimizing Care for Patients With Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers propose a personalized treatment framework for advanced prostate cancer integrating molecular testing, imaging, and supportive care to optimize outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Right-Sizing Locoregional Management in the Era of Neoadjuvant Therapy for Breast Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Breast cancer treatment is shifting toward reduced surgery and radiation based on how well tumors respond to pre-surgery chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Precision Immunotherapy: Revolutionizing Cancer Treatment With Targeted Innovations.
biomarkers.summary: Targeted immunotherapies like T-cell engagers and antibody-drug conjugates offer more selective cancer treatment with better outcomes in specific tumors, though toxicity management remains challenging.

biomarkers.title: Modern Management of Mantle Cell Lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary: Mantle cell lymphoma treatment now uses risk-adapted strategies combining targeted drugs like BTK inhibitors with traditional chemotherapy for improved survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Promising New Platforms and Targets in the Management of Gastroesophageal Cancers.
biomarkers.summary: Gastric and gastroesophageal junction cancers show improved survival with immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and new biomarker-guided treatment approaches.

biomarkers.title: When tumor contact reshapes CAR-T cells.
biomarkers.summary: Repeated exposure to tumors damages CAR-T immune cells' ability to process antigens, reducing their cancer-fighting function.

biomarkers.title: Follow the data: tracking data quality and completeness in oncology real-world data.
biomarkers.summary: Study shows data quality problems when cancer patient information transfers between electronic health record systems and registries.

biomarkers.title: Infertility as a possible diagnostic feature of Carney complex.
biomarkers.summary: Male infertility and testicular damage may be an underrecognized sign of Carney complex, a rare genetic syndrome with multiple tumors.

biomarkers.title: TTF-1-positive primary papillary epithelial tumor of the sella with long-term recurrence after multiple resections.
biomarkers.summary: A rare brain tumor near the pituitary gland recurred repeatedly over ten years despite multiple surgeries, highlighting diagnostic challenges.

biomarkers.title: [Occurrence characteristics， neurotoxicity risk， and potential mechanisms of traditional phthalate esters and novel alternatives in indoor dust].
biomarkers.summary: Phthalate plasticizers in indoor dust, particularly in dormitories, pose neurotoxicity risks through ingestion, especially for young women, via disrupted cellular signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: [Polydimethylsiloxane microfluidic aptasensor： opening a new era of biomarker point-of-care testing].
biomarkers.summary: PDMS microfluidic aptasensors enable fast, affordable, portable cancer biomarker detection for point-of-care testing.

biomarkers.title: Pencil-drawn paper-based portable photoelectrochemical immunoassay of carbohydrate antigen 19-9 based on TiO2 hollow cube homogeneous junctions.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a paper-based test using pencil drawings to quickly detect cancer marker CA 19-9 for community screening.

biomarkers.title: Resolving lipid isomers up to the double bond position level using reversed-phase chromatography, EAD fragmentation, and high-resolution mass spectrometry: Application to pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a method using chromatography and mass spectrometry to precisely identify lipid structures in pancreatic cancer samples.

biomarkers.title: Modulating glymphatic clearance in Alzheimer's disease: Molecular mechanisms, imaging biomarkers, and emerging interventions.
biomarkers.summary: Improving brain fluid clearance through sleep optimization, exercise, and aquaporin-4 targeting may help remove toxic proteins in Alzheimer's disease.

trials.title: Bereaved Caregiver Perspectives on Quality of Care at the End of Life Among Adolescents and Young Adults with Cancer.
trials.summary: Bereaved caregivers report that standard measures don't adequately capture end-of-life care quality for adolescents and young adults with cancer.

trials.title: A novel insulin-like growth factor II-based masking domain for conditional activation of therapeutic antibodies.
trials.summary: Scientists engineered a masking protein that blocks therapeutic antibodies until enzymes at disease sites activate them, improving safety and effectiveness.

trials.summary: Gastric and gastroesophageal junction cancers show improved survival with immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy and new biomarker-guided treatment approaches.

trials.title: Aberrant brain activity during sad-happy emotional switching in adolescents with bipolar disorder: A functional MRI study.
trials.summary: Brain scans reveal abnormal activity patterns when adolescents with bipolar disorder switch between sad and happy emotions.

trials.title: Video Education With Clinical Genetic Testing Coordinators for the Rapid Evaluation of Patients With Cancers: Real-World Evidence.
trials.summary: Video education with genetic coordinators speeds up cancer genetic testing while maintaining quality care and reducing wait times for patients.

trials.title: Targeting TROP2 and Exploiting AUNIP as a Determinant of ADC Cytotoxicity and Chemosensitivity in HNSCC and ESCA Cancers.
trials.summary: Researchers found that targeting TROP2 with a cancer drug effectively treats head and neck and esophageal cancers, with enhanced effectiveness when AUNIP is eliminated.

trials.title: Prostate-Specific Membrane Antigen Imaging and Initial Treatment for Prostate Cancer.
trials.summary: A study found that PSMA imaging helps doctors choose better initial treatments for prostate cancer patients.

trials.title: Rates of Systemic Treatment for Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Among Older Adults.
trials.summary: Older adults with advanced lung cancer may not be receiving newer, more effective treatments available in recent decades.

trials.title: Ketotifen for Preventing Oxaliplatin-Induced Neuropathy in Stage III Colorectal Cancer: a Randomized Controlled Trial.
trials.summary: Ketotifen may help prevent nerve damage caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy in stage III colorectal cancer patients.

trials.title: Knowledge mapping of ⁹⁰Y transarterial radioembolization combined with immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma: a bibliometric analysis.
trials.summary: Combining radiation therapy with immunotherapy shows promise for treating liver cancer, with research growing globally but needing more clinical trials.

trials.title: Zolbetuximab plus chemotherapy in Japanese patients with claudin 18.2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma: a combined subgroup analysis of the phase 3 SPOTLIGHT and GLOW trials.
trials.summary: Zolbetuximab combined with chemotherapy improves survival in Japanese patients with claudin 18.2-positive gastric cancer.
